Public bytes-input safe mapping API for verified Git bytes. Reuse same unique SafeLoader and mapping/schema checks; preserve path API behavior, merge/alias/duplicate/unsafe semantics. No copied/private loader dependency in new module.
Bytes/path parity and accepted YAML/contracts preservation regression, without mutable-current fixture dependency.

module_boundary_decision.reason: Current master contains accepted route/queue engine and immutable contracts. Integrity/provenance/snapshot assembly form one read boundary; delegate routing to existing owner.
module_boundary_decision.schemas: No new governance schema or route vocabulary required. Immutable diagnostic/snapshot values are implementation types, not authority documents.
proposed_api: GitBlobReader resolve/read exact commit+blob (injected; production adapter strictly read-only Git object access)
verify_manifest_bindings verified raw bytes against declared exact refs/hashes -> immutable IntegrityReport
resolve_repository_snapshot pointer-first single-commit reads -> immutable RepositorySnapshot plus existing RouteDecision
load_yaml_mapping_bytes verified bytes -> same safe mapping semantics; optional contract selection reuses existing contract registry/model_validate
module_boundary_decision.freshness_boundary: Caller supplies freshly rehydrated authoritative commit and provenance; read-only Git object adapter proves object/commit consistency, never claims remote freshness from a cached local ref. Any current-source compatibility drift requires fresh preflight before authority/execution.

foundation.source_binding: Current accepted master blobs; contracts/test_contracts evolved through accepted Program V2, not historical AUTO-IMP-001 closure blobs as current identity.

semantic_requirements: Verify exact Git object identities and declared SHA-256 over raw blob bytes; no worktree/newline normalization.
Pin the complete snapshot and provenance to one caller-supplied freshly rehydrated authoritative commit. Ref movement must invalidate/revalidate, never mix reads across HEAD.

Repository-first/pointer-first: CURRENT_CODEX, optional CURRENT_CODEX_TASK, exact referenced artifacts; relevant CURRENT_STATE only for unresolved governance; historical context on ambiguity/failure/provenance only.
Read current lifecycle and status before candidate-only authorization/package/program/dependency deep bindings. Non-candidate status must return deterministic STOP/PENDING/status, never KeyError.
Only a genuine execution-candidate route loads complete required identity/revision/scope/profile/dependency/effect/provider bindings. Missing/duplicate/ambiguous/incompatible bindings fail closed.
Status-only never invokes, dispatches, reserves, consumes, creates authority or resumes an executor.
Use accepted orchestration.resolve_route(OrchestrationSnapshot) for routing; proposal != authority, invocation_allowed=false. No duplicate queue/priority/capacity/lifecycle algorithm.
Historical embedded CURRENT text, manifest candidate-phase snapshots and immutable Program phase snapshots cannot override canonical current lifecycle plus bound accepted evidence.
Strict unknown-schema/field handling follows existing contracts. Unsafe YAML and duplicate explicit/nested keys remain rejected; merge precedence and recursive/alias compatibility preserved.
All side effects denied; AUTO-IMP-003 remains NOT_AUTHORIZED; controller NOT_ACTIVE and CONTROLLED_AUTO DISABLED.
Read-only Git adapter permits only commit/blob inspection, no fetch/push/checkout/reset/merge/config mutations/provider/executor/DB/network I/O.
Exact contradictions return an explicit diagnostic with canonical STOP/reconciliation result; never repair authority, hashes, protected files or historical evidence.

Do not interpret permissive OrchestrationSnapshot default values as proven authority/provider/lifecycle facts. Candidate-required evidence must be present and validated explicitly; absent evidence fails closed.
